lina (Docs): FYI opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/478 to tighten the rate-limit examples and add a short migration note for dashboard panel renames. need an analytics owner to confirm new panel id and an eng reviewer for the quota header example. @maya @ric
alex (PM): thanks. main product ask: should docs refer to the UI label as 'Billing Tier' or keep 'Usage Tier'? product copy debate continues but docs should reflect UX. i'd prefer matching the latest UI.
ric (Runtime Eng): product is switching to "Billing Tier" in the console next week. docs should use "Billing Tier". also ensure examples show X-Redwood-Quota and X-Redwood-Account headers. here's a concise curl example you can copy: 
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings" \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \\
  -H "X-Redwood-Account: acct_789" \\
  -H "X-Redwood-Quota: tier=pro" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"input": "search text"}'
```
lina (Docs): nice. i'll include both curl and a tiny Python requests example showing header + simple error check. also found a broken dashboard link in rate-limits.md: /dash/old/usage -> 404. @maya can you confirm the new panel and whether we need to update the public dashboard URL?
maya (Analytics): confirmed. old path is deprecated. new panel is https://dash.redwood.ai/d/abc123/usage-overview. i'll put a redirect in place but please update docs to point at the new URL. note: metric rename last sprint: `ingested_tokens` -> `tokens_ingested`. if any sample queries use the old metric, add a migration callout.
lina (Docs): good call — will add migration callout under "Metrics and dashboards". suggested copy: "If your alerts or queries reference ingested_tokens, update to tokens_ingested. Example: `sum(tokens_ingested) by billing_tier`"
alex (PM): also add a short FAQ bullet: "Will switching labels affect saved queries?" with answer: "Saved queries using field names are unaffected; metric name changes may require edits."
ric (Runtime Eng): small nit for the header format: we use `X-Redwood-Quota: tier:pro` (colon), not equals. update examples to show both colon and equals variants and call out server will accept either but we prefer colon.
lina (Docs): ok will mention both and prefer colon. drafting python snippet now. aiming to merge today after link-checker passes.
link-checker-bot: Link check: 2 warnings — internal /dash/old/usage -> 404, relative link ../pricing -> redirect detected.
lina (Docs): thx bot. i'll fix the relative pricing link to /pricing and update the dashboard URL. tagging @maya for final thumbs up before merge. :spiral_note_pad:
